figures.caption: FIGURE 6 Schematic illustration of the new theoretical paradigm and rule between the thermal stability of a SE and its structure. The new theoretical paradigm is presented from three perspectives, namely “performance-structure-rule”. From a macroscopic point of view, thermal stability is the performance of ASSBs, which is determined by their main components. From a microscopic perspective, the thermal stability of each solid-state electrolyte material is determined by its structure, which is further subdivided into the crystal structure, polyhedra structure, and bonding. The macroscopic and microscopic relationships are summarized as linear rules involving factors such as the structure of the material, chemical bonding, and energy correction factor k
